::: {#exr-sum .callout-exercise}
Add the first ten positive integers.
:::

::: {.callout-solution}
Fifty-five, by pairing the ends.
:::

Pairing the ends is worth remembering; it generalizes to any arithmetic series.

::: {#exr-mean .callout-exercise}
State the mean of a fair die.
:::

::: {.callout-solution}
Three and a half.
:::
